== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Diversionary Tactics (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1230_102</code>, Virtual Block 3 slip 103), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-103-Diversionary_Tactics.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-L-diversionarytactics-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Diversionary Tactics (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: Target one piloted starship at a system. That starship is hyperspeed -1 for remainder of turn.LOST: If you have 2 unique () piloted Rebel (or [Republic]) starfighters in battle at a system, draw destiny. If destiny < 4, exclude one starship from that battle.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1230_102</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 3 set mark, slip number 103, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
